# Predicates asserted from non-test Go that no .mg file declares.
#
# Each of these is a fact the code believes it recorded. Assert returns nil,
# the fact lands in the EDB, and Query can never return it, because the
# fixpoint only derives what the program declares.
#
# Fix one by declaring it AND giving it a consumer, or by dropping the assert.
#
# Declaring it alone is not the fix, and no gate will tell you so. A
# predicate that is declared, written by Go, and read by no rule body is
# the fourth direction (see starved_atom_value_test.go) and this package
# deliberately does not measure it: it is NOT starved, which requires a
# rule to read it, and it is no longer undeclared. It leaves this list and
# arrives nowhere. Check the consumer yourself.
#
# Regenerate: CODENERD_UPDATE_UNDECLARED=1 go test ./internal/core/defaults/ -run TestUndeclaredAssertBudget
